problem: The nested shape requires every requiredAccessItem value to also be an equipmentItem, but the locked vocabulary identifies requiredAccessItem as a distinct class with range protectedItem and provides no subclass relationship to equipmentItem. This invented type intersection can reject valid required access items and changes the requirement's applicability.
required_change: Remove sh:class nltl:equipmentItem from the nested required-access shape; retain the means-presence constraint on each value reached through nltl:hasRequiredAccessItem.
regression_guard: Preserve the per-required-access traversal and the sh:minCount 1 constraint on nltl:hasIceOrSnowRemovalOrPreventionMeans.
